formData.subject: COMPONENTS LIST FOR SYNTHETIC FIELD TRAINING KIT
formData.supersedure: Supersedes SL-3-54321A dated 31 October 2025. Fictional publication for layout review only.

sl3.technicalData: FICTIONAL TRAINING PUBLICATION - NOT FOR OPERATIONAL USE. The Synthetic Field Training Kit (SFTK) is a nonfunctional demonstration assembly. Packed dimensions: 24 by 18 by 12 inches. Packed mass: 32 pounds. Nominal supply: 24 volts direct current (VDC); no energized components are supplied. The Quick Disconnect Interface (QDI) links the training indicator to the case. Applicability code A1 identifies the baseline model; A2 identifies the alternate housing. All identifiers, quantities, configuration records and approval references in this sample are fabricated.
sl3.sourceManual: TM 54321A-10, Synthetic Field Training Kit, 28 October 2026 (fictional)
sl3.configurationReference: Synthetic configuration record SFTK-2026-010, revision 3, 28 October 2026; fabricated for software review.
sl3.fieldingPlanReference: Synthetic Fielding Plan SFTK-FP-003, revision 2, 28 October 2026; model and reference-designator columns authorized for this fictional review.
sl3.sequencingNote: Items are arranged by functional assembly, followed by collateral material and using-unit items. Children remain immediately below their parent assembly. This fictional sequence exercises subordinate component indentation and multiple responsibility categories.

definitions.meaning: Synthetic Field Training Kit - a fictional equipment assembly for testing completed publication layout.
Quick Disconnect Interface - a simulated mechanical interface connecting the training indicator module to its carrying case without tools.
Applicability code for the baseline synthetic training-kit configuration.
Applicability code for the alternate synthetic housing configuration.

notes.text: Inventory the complete parent assembly and each subordinate component together. All training parts are inert; this sample does not authorize equipment operation or substitute for an approved technical manual.

For applicability A2, substitute the alternate housing listed in the synthetic Fielding Plan. Preserve the recorded parent-to-child association and reconcile serial numbers before signing the inventory record.
